title: Ball Resting on Clubhouse Patio
question:
Your approach shot goes long and comes to rest on the clubhouse patio behind the green. The patio is part of the course and is not out of bounds or marked as a No Play Zone.

What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You must play the ball as it lies.
You are entitled to free relief because the patio is an immovable obstruction.
You must take an unplayable ball with a one-stroke penalty.
You may drop anywhere off the patio without penalty.

explanation: A paved clubhouse patio is an immovable obstruction. If your ball lies on the patio, or the patio interferes with your stance or intended swing, you are entitled to free relief under Rule 16.1. You must find the nearest point of complete relief, no closer to the hole, and drop the ball within one club-length of that point in the relief area. Always check Local Rules, as some areas may be defined differently.
